description:
Fetch live items from a registered content data source — the same door a kind='dynamic' component binds to (Live Data). Sibling of list_data_sources.

Use this to PREVIEW what a dynamic component will render, or to discover a source's row shape before wiring a component's `sources`. It returns real, published, tenant-scoped records.

Sources: posts, authors, categories, tags, changelog, plus the tenant’s own `idap.*` collections. `idap.businesses` SERVES REAL ROWS (verified live 2026-09-03) — the old 501 is gone. Not every registered source is servable: a non-servable one (e.g. `idap.streets`) answers 422 DATA_SOURCE_NOT_SERVABLE, a singleton like `idap.lead` answers 422 (those reach /lp/ templates as `lead`), and an unregistered id 404s. Rows are tenant-scoped — isolation was proven on the wire, and injected `client_id`/`schema` params are refused.

Filtering: pass `filter` keys matching the source's filterable fields (discover via list_data_sources), e.g. {"tag":"news"} on posts. `sort` is a single field with optional ":asc"/":desc" (or "-field"); `sort` orders the WHOLE source, not the page. `fields` trims the returned keys.

🔴 PAGING: `offset` IS CAPPED AT 10,000. offset=10001 → 422 OFFSET_CAP_EXCEEDED (it refuses; it does not quietly return page 1). Past that point `after` is the ONLY way through — pass back the `next_cursor` from the previous response and send NO offset. On a large corpus that is most of the data: one tenant holds ~274k rows, of which offset paging reaches 10k. Use `after` for any walk you expect to exceed a few pages; `offset` is fine for a preview. `limit` is 1-500.

Returns { items: [...], total, source_id, next_cursor? }. `total` saturates at a count ceiling on very large sources — read a suspiciously round total as "at least this many", not as exact. Public read (X-Content-Domain tenant scope).

after.description: Keyset cursor: the `next_cursor` from the previous response. The ONLY way past the 10,000-row offset cap. Send it INSTEAD of offset, not alongside.

fields.description: Project to these field ids only (default: all).

filter.description: Filter by the source's filterable fields, e.g. {"tag":"news","category":"..."}.

offset.description: Pagination offset (default 0). HARD CAP 10000 — offset=10001 is a 422 naming the cap, not an empty page. Use `after` to go further.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

source_id.description: Registered source id (list_data_sources). v1: posts, authors, categories, tags, changelog.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: list_data_source_items
